questions.question: What are the teams with the most technicians?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Team FROM technician GROUP BY Team ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find the country of origin for the artist who made the least number of songs?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.country FROM artist AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.artist_name  =  T2.artist_name GROUP BY T2.artist_name ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find the names and number of works of the three artists who have produced the most songs.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.artist_name ,  count(*) FROM artist AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.artist_name  =  T2.artist_name GROUP BY T2.artist_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: List the name of the pilots who have flied for both a company that mainly provide 'Cargo' services and a company that runs 'Catering services' activities.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.pilot FROM operate_company AS T1 JOIN flight AS t2 ON T1.id  =  T2.company_id WHERE T1.principal_activities  =  'Cargo' INTERSECT SELECT T2.pilot FROM operate_company AS T1 JOIN flight AS t2 ON T1.id  =  T2.company_id WHERE T1.principal_activities  =  'Catering services'

questions.question: which pilot is in charge of the most number of flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT pilot FROM flight GROUP BY pilot ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many faculty members did the university that conferred the most degrees in 2002 have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.faculty FROM campuses AS T1 JOIN faculty AS T2 ON T1.id  =  t2.campus JOIN degrees AS T3 ON T1.id  =  t3.campus AND t2.year  =  t3.year WHERE t2.year  =  2002 ORDER BY t3.degrees DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the name and code of the location with the smallest number of documents?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.location_name ,  T1.location_code FROM Document_locations AS T1 JOIN Ref_locations AS T2 ON T1.location_code  =  T2.location_code GROUP BY T1.location_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show the role code with the least employees.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT role_code FROM Employees GROUP BY role_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the location code with the most documents?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT location_code FROM Document_locations GROUP BY location_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which service id and type has the least number of participants?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.service_id ,  T4.Service_Type_Code FROM participants AS T1 JOIN Participants_in_Events AS T2 ON T1.Participant_ID  =  T2.Participant_ID JOIN EVENTS AS T3 ON T2.Event_ID   =  T3.Event_ID JOIN services AS T4 ON T3.service_id  =  T4.service_id GROUP BY T3.service_id ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which themes have had corresponding exhibitions that have had attendance both below 100 and above 500?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.theme FROM exhibition_record AS T1 JOIN exhibition AS T2 ON T1.exhibition_id  =  T2.exhibition_id WHERE T1.attendance  <  100 INTERSECT SELECT T2.theme FROM exhibition_record AS T1 JOIN exhibition AS T2 ON T1.exhibition_id  =  T2.exhibition_id WHERE T1.attendance  >  500

questions.question: In 2014, what are the id and rank of the team that has the largest average number of attendance?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.team_id ,  T2.rank FROM home_game AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id  =  T2.team_id WHERE T1.year  =  2014 GROUP BY T1.team_id ORDER BY avg(T1.attendance) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What are the manager's first name, last name and id who won the most manager award?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name_first ,  T1.name_last ,  T2.player_id FROM player AS T1 JOIN manager_award AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T2.player_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Which products has been complained by the customer who has filed least amount of complaints?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.product_name FROM products AS t1 JOIN complaints AS t2 ON t1.product_id  =  t2.product_id JOIN customers AS t3 GROUP BY t3.customer_id ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which state has the most customers?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT state FROM customers GROUP BY state ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Return the names of products that have had complaints filed by the customer who has filed the fewest complaints.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.product_name FROM products AS t1 JOIN complaints AS t2 ON t1.product_id  =  t2.product_id JOIN customers AS t3 GROUP BY t3.customer_id ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which policy type has the most records in the database?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT policy_type_code FROM available_policies GROUP BY policy_type_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: List the time of elimination of the wrestlers with largest days held.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Time FROM elimination AS T1 JOIN wrestler AS T2 ON T1.Wrestler_ID  =  T2.Wrestler_ID ORDER BY T2.Days_held DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the time of elimination for the wrestler with the most days held?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Time FROM elimination AS T1 JOIN wrestler AS T2 ON T1.Wrestler_ID  =  T2.Wrestler_ID ORDER BY T2.Days_held DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which parties have more than 20 hosts? Give me the host names for these parties.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name FROM party_host AS T1 JOIN HOST AS T2 ON T1.Host_ID  =  T2.Host_ID JOIN party AS T3 ON T1.Party_ID  =  T3.Party_ID WHERE T3.Number_of_hosts  >  20

questions.question: Find all students taught by OTHA MOYER. Output the first and last names of the students.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.firstname ,  T1.lastname FROM list AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.classroom  =  T2.classroom WHERE T2.firstname  =  "OTHA" AND T2.lastname  =  "MOYER"

questions.question: Which teachers teach the student named EVELINA BROMLEY? Give me the first and last name  of the teachers.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.firstname ,  T2.lastname FROM list AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.classroom  =  T2.classroom WHERE T1.firstname  =  "EVELINA" AND T1.lastname  =  "BROMLEY"

questions.question: Find all students taught by MARROTTE KIRK. Output first and last names of students.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.firstname ,  T1.lastname FROM list AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.classroom  =  T2.classroom WHERE T2.firstname  =  "MARROTTE" AND T2.lastname  =  "KIRK"

questions.question: Find the name of the teacher who teaches the largest number of students.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.firstname ,  T2.lastname FROM list AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.classroom  =  T2.classroom GROUP BY T2.firstname ,  T2.lastname ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the names of the cameras that have taken picture of the most mountains?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM photos AS T1 JOIN camera_lens AS T2 ON T1.camera_lens_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show storm name with at least two regions and 10 cities affected.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM storm AS T1 JOIN affected_region AS T2 ON T1.storm_id  =  T2.storm_id GROUP BY T1.storm_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2 INTERSECT SELECT T1.name FROM storm AS T1 JOIN affected_region AS T2 ON T1.storm_id  =  T2.storm_id GROUP BY T1.storm_id HAVING sum(T2.number_city_affected)  >=  10

questions.question: Which month has the most happy hours?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MONTH FROM happy_hour GROUP BY MONTH ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the details of the markets that can be accessed by walk or bus?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Market_Details FROM Street_Markets AS T1 JOIN TOURIST_ATTRACTIONS AS T2 ON T1.Market_ID  =  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID WHERE T2.How_to_Get_There  =  "walk" OR  T2.How_to_Get_There  =  "bus"

questions.question: What is the maximum total amount paid by a customer? List the customer id and amount.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id ,  sum(amount_paid) FROM Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY sum(amount_paid) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the order dates of orders with price higher than 1000?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Order_Date FROM Customer_Orders AS T1 JOIN ORDER_ITEMS AS T2 ON T1.Order_ID  =  T2.Order_ID JOIN Products AS T3 ON T2.Product_ID  =  T3.Product_ID WHERE T3.Product_price  >  1000

questions.question: What are the different ids and stop durations of all the drivers whose stop lasted longer than the driver in the race with the id 841?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT driverid ,  STOP FROM pitstops WHERE duration  >  (SELECT min(duration) FROM pitstops WHERE raceid  =  841)

questions.question: What are the ids and last names of all drivers who participated in the most races?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.driverid ,  T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceid = T3.raceid GROUP BY T1.driverid ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the title and director of the films without any schedule?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT title ,  directed_by FROM film WHERE film_id NOT IN (SELECT film_id FROM schedule)

questions.question: What is the location with the most cinemas opened in year 2010 or later?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT LOCATION FROM cinema WHERE openning_year  >=  2010 GROUP BY LOCATION ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
